headword: {法的責任|ほうてきせきにん}

definitions.explanation: the obligation or accountability imposed by law, including both civil and criminal responsibility

examples.japanese: {法的責任|ほうてきせきにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}われる→問う：02299_tou⟧。

⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{法的責任|ほうてきせきにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧。
examples.english: Companies bear legal responsibility for their employees' actions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦どのような→どのような：09961_donoyouna⟧{法的責任|ほうてきせきにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I consulted a lawyer to confirm what kind of legal responsibility I had.

notes:
A formal compound combining ⟦{法的|ほうてき}→法的：13300_houteki⟧ (legal) and ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧ (responsibility). Used in legal, business, and news contexts to describe obligations enforceable by law. Encompasses both ⟦{民事責任|みんじせきにん}→民事責任：25819_minjisekinin⟧ (civil liability) and ⟦{刑事責任|けいじせきにん}→刑事責任：25820_keijisekinin⟧ (criminal liability).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法的責任|ほうてきせきにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧: to bear legal responsibility
- {法的責任|ほうてきせきにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}う→問う：02299_tou⟧: to hold someone legally accountable
- {法的責任|ほうてきせきにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追及|ついきゅう}する→追及する：21385_tsuikyuu⟧: to pursue legal accountability
- {法的責任|ほうてきせきにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}れる→逃れる：10425_nogareru⟧: to escape legal liability

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {損害賠償責任|そんがいばいしょうせきにん}: liability for damages — specifically financial compensation obligations
- {道義的責任|どうぎてきせきにん}: moral responsibility — ethical rather than legal obligation
- {管理責任|かんりせきにん}: supervisory responsibility — responsibility for oversight and management
